data.name: Fauji Foods Limited
data.description: Fauji Foods Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 26 September 1966 as a Public Company under the Companies Act, 1913 (now the Companies Act, 2017). The Company is a subsidiary of Fauji Fertilizer Bin Qasim Limited (the Parent Company). The Company is principally engaged in processing and sale of toned milk, milk powder, fruit juices, allied dairy and food products.
